description: Comprehensive open-SaaS ecommerce platform providing extensive REST and GraphQL APIs for store management, headless storefronts, carts, and checkout.
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for public apps; static access tokens (X-Auth-Token header) and client IDs for store/account level accounts; JWTs for storefront and customer auth.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free 15-day trial sandbox store to generate API credentials directly in the control panel or Developer Portal.
api_notes: Extensive coverage of ecommerce operations including catalog, orders, customers, checkouts, carts, metafields, webhooks, and B2B management.
mcp_notes: BigCommerce provides an official Docs MCP Server (and experimental store management/storefront MCP options in developer resources).
rationale: The APIs are fully public and documented with comprehensive SDKs and sandboxes, but live API credentials require signing up for a trial store or paid subscription plan.

evidence.note: Details OAuth scopes, token creation, X-Auth-Token headers, and JWT/storefront authentication methods.
Explains getting started by creating a free sandbox trial store and generating API credentials via the control panel.
Provides complete REST and GraphQL API specifications and endpoints across admin, storefront, and account management.
Outlines the 15-day free trial and tier structure required to operate stores and maintain active API access.
Mentions the official Docs MCP Server and MCP toolkits for connecting AI agents to documentation and store tools.
